div.div:
Safety boundary
Tokens stay out of config/cache/output. Requests and issue targets are repository-scoped.
Cache/config writes use safe paths and file-mutation queues; IssueMe mutations run sequentially.
No GitHub CLI, webhooks, listeners, or automatic issue changes from editing a cache file.
